t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. SAMBAAN KO, O DIOS KO, YA SIKAY AMALSA ED SIAK PIAN KABETEN TAKA. TAN GALANGEN TAKA. TESTIGUAN KO ED SAYAN BERTA SO KAKAPOYAN KO TAN SAY PAKAPANYARIM, SAY KAPOBRIYAN KO TAN SAY INKAYAMAN MO. ANGGAPOY AROM A DIOS NO AGSAY SIKA, MANANULONG ED KAIRAPAN, ONTALINDEG-ED-KABUKBUKORAN.
